```{r}


library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)

# 1. clean data
wvs_r <- wvs |>
  select(
    country = B_COUNTRY_ALPHA,
    imm = Q21
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(country), imm > 0) |>
  mutate(
    anti_imm = if_else(imm == 1, 1, 0)
  )

# 2. aggregate
country_wvs <- wvs_r |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(
    anti_imm_rate = mean(anti_imm),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 50)

# 3. map
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

map_data <- world |>
  left_join(country_df, by = c("iso_a3" = "country"))

# 4. plot
ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = anti_imm_rate)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    labels = scales::percent,
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Anti-Immigrant Attitudes Across Countries (WVS Wave 7)",
    fill = "Share rejecting immigrants",
    caption = "Inglehart, R et al. 2022. World Values Survey: 
    Round Seven - Country-Pooled Datafile Version 5.0. 
    Madrid, Spain & Vienna, Austria: JD Systems Institute & WVSA Secretariat. 
    doi:10.14281/18241.24
 
"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  filename = paste0("Home/HEB126 Research/outcome/immigration_map_", Sys.Date(), ".png"),
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


```

```{r}


library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(countrycode)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(ggplot2)


religion_country <- wvs %>%
  transmute(
    country = B_COUNTRY_ALPHA,   # usually ISO alpha-3 country code
    god_importance = as.numeric(Q164)
  ) %>%
  filter(god_importance > 0) %>%  # removes -1, -2, -4, -5
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_god_importance = mean(god_importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

map_data <- world %>%
  left_join(religion_country, by = c("iso_a3" = "country"))

ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_god_importance), color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    na.value = "grey85",
    limits = c(1, 10),
    name = "Importance of God\ncountry mean"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Religiosity across countries",
    subtitle = "World Values Survey Wave 7, Q164: Importance of God, 1–10 scale",
    caption = "Negative WVS missing codes removed: Don't know, No answer, Not asked, Missing"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


ggsave("religion_map.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```
```{r}


country_combined <- religion_country |>
```

```{r}

wvs <- wvs |>
  mutate(
    exclusivism = case_when(
      Q170 %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,   # agree
      Q170 %in% c(3, 4) ~ 0,   # disagree
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

country_religion_exclusion <- wvs |>
  group_by(country = B_COUNTRY_ALPHA) |>
  summarise(
   
    exclusivism_rate = mean(exclusivism, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 50)

country_combined <- country_df |>
  inner_join(country_religion_exclusion, by = "country")

lm(anti_imm_rate ~ exclusivism_rate, data = country_combined)
```

```{r final-modal-table, error=TRUE, warning=TRUE, message=TRUE}


library(haven)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Load witchcraft dataset
witch <- read_dta("~/Downloads/dataverse_files/plos_data_country.dta")
glimpse(witch)
# 2. Clean it (keep only what you need)
witch_clean <- witch |>
  transmute(
    country = isocode,
    witchcraft_rate = witchcraft
  )

# 3. Merge with your existing dataset
# (assumes you already have: country_combined_full)
country_combined_full <- country_combined |>
  inner_join(witch_clean, by = "country")


country_belief <- wvs |>
  transmute(
    country = B_COUNTRY_ALPHA,
    belief = (as.numeric(Q164) - 1) / 9
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(belief)) |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(
    belief_mean = mean(belief, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_belief = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_belief >= 50)

country_combined_full <- country_df |>
  inner_join(country_religion_exclusion, by = "country") |>
  inner_join(country_belief, by = "country") |>
  inner_join(witch_clean, by = "country")

# Model 1: belief only
model1 <- lm(
  anti_imm_rate ~ belief_mean,
  data = country_combined_full
)

# Model 2: exclusivism only
model2 <- lm(
  anti_imm_rate ~ exclusivism_rate,
  data = country_combined_full
)

# Model 3: full model
model3 <- lm(
  anti_imm_rate ~ witchcraft_rate,
  data = country_combined_full
)


summary(model1)
summary(model2)
summary(model3)

modelsummary(
  list(
    "Model 1: Belief" = model1,
    "Model 2: Exclusivism" = model2,
    "Model 3: Full Model" = model3
  ),
  coef_map = c(
    belief_mean = "Religious belief",
    exclusivism_rate = "Religious exclusivism",
    witchcraft_rate = "Witchcraft belief"
  ),
  stars = TRUE,
  gof_omit = "IC|Log|Adj",
  output = "regression_table.html"
)



model <- lm(
  anti_imm_rate ~ belief_mean + exclusivism_rate + witchcraft_rate,
  data = country_combined_full
)

summary(model)

# 4. Run regression




country_belief <- wvs |>
  transmute(
    country = B_COUNTRY_ALPHA,
    belief = (as.numeric(Q164) - 1) / 9   # 👈 rescale
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(belief)) |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(
    belief_mean = mean(belief, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 50)

country_combined_full <- country_df |>
  inner_join(country_religion_exclusion, by = "country") |>

model <- lm(anti_imm_rate ~ belief_mean + exclusivism_rate,

)
```

```{r}

library(haven)
library(dplyr)

witch <- read_dta("~/Downloads/dataverse_files/plos_data_country.dta")


witch_clean <- witch |>
  transmute(
    country = isocode,
    witchcraft_rate = witchcraft
  )

country_combined_full <- country_df |>
  inner_join(country_religion_exclusion, by = "country") |>
  inner_join(country_belief, by = "country")

country_combined_full <- country_combined_full |>
  inner_join(witch_clean, by = "country")

# Model 1
m1 <- lm(witchcraft_rate ~ belief_mean, data = country_combined_full)

# Model 2
m2 <- lm(witchcraft_rate ~ exclusivism_rate, data = country_combined_full)

# Model 3
m3 <- lm(witchcraft_rate ~ belief_mean + exclusivism_rate,
         data = country_combined_full)

modelsummary(
  list("Belief only" = m1,
       "Exclusivism only" = m2,
       "Both" = m3),
  coef_map = c(
    belief_mean = "Religious belief",
    exclusivism_rate = "Religious exclusivism"
  ),
  statistic = "({std.error})",
  stars = TRUE,
  output = "table2.html"
)




```

```{r}


library(dplyr)

wvs_ind <- wvs |>
  transmute(
    country = B_COUNTRY_ALPHA,
    
    # DV: immigration attitude
    imm = as.numeric(Q21),
    anti_imm = if_else(imm == 1, 1, 0),  # 1 = reject, 0 = others
    
    # IVs
    belief = (as.numeric(Q164) - 1) / 9,
    
    exclusivism = case_when(
      Q170 %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,
      Q170 %in% c(3, 4) ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(anti_imm),
    !is.na(belief),
    !is.na(exclusivism),
    !is.na(country)
  )



library(fixest)

model_ind <- feols(anti_imm ~ belief + exclusivism | country, data = wvs_ind)

library(modelsummary)

modelsummary(
  list("Individual-level FE" = model_ind),
  coef_map = c(
    belief = "Religious belief",
    exclusivism = "Religious exclusivism"
  ),
  stars = TRUE
)


modelsummary(
  list(
    "Model 1: Belief" = model1,
    "Model 2: Exclusivism" = model2,
    "Model 3: Full Model" = model3
  ),
  coef_map = c(
    belief_mean = "Religious belief",
    exclusivism_rate = "Religious exclusivism",
    witchcraft_rate = "Witchcraft belief"
  ),
  stars = TRUE,
  gof_omit = "IC|Log|Adj",
  output = "regression_table.html"
)




```


```{r}


#Create an individual level witchcraft data and merge it with individual level wvs



common_countries <- intersect(
  unique(wvs_ind$country),
  unique(witch_clean$country)
)
length(common_countries)



wvs_indmerge <- wvs_ind |>
  filter(country %in% common_countries)

witch_cleanmerge <- witch_clean |>
  filter(country %in% common_countries)


wvs_full <- wvs_indmerge |>
  left_join(witch_cleanmerge, by = "country")

mean(is.na(wvs_full$witchcrraft_rate))

nrow(wvs_ind)
nrow(wvs_indmerge)
nrow(witch_cleanmerge)
nrow(wvs_full)

intersect(sort(unique(wvs_ind$country)), sort(unique(witch_clean$country)))
length(intersect(unique(wvs_ind$country), unique(witch_clean$country)))



wvs_final <- wvs_full |>
  filter(!is.na(witchcraft_rate))


library(fixest)

model_fe_witch <- feols(
  anti_imm ~ belief + exclusivism + belief:witchcraft_rate | country,
  data = wvs_final,
  cluster = ~country
)

summary(model_fe_witch)


model_exclu_witch <- feols(
  exclusivism ~ belief + witchcraft_rate | country,
  data = wvs_final,
  cluster = ~country
)

summary(model_exclu_witch)


wvs_ind <- wvs |>
  transmute(
    country = B_COUNTRY_ALPHA,
    anti_imm = if_else(Q21 == 1, 1, 0),
    
    belief = (as.numeric(Q164) - 1) / 9,
    
    exclusivism = case_when(
      Q170 %in% c(1,2) ~ 1,
      Q170 %in% c(3,4) ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    # proxy: belief in supernatural
    supernatural = as.numeric(Q165)  # replace with correct variable
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(anti_imm), !is.na(belief), !is.na(exclusivism), !is.na(supernatural))




```


```{r}


##supernatural beliefs in country

wvs_ind <- wvs |>
  transmute(
    country = B_COUNTRY_ALPHA,
    
    anti_imm = if_else(Q21 == 1, 1, 0),
    
    belief = (as.numeric(Q164) - 1) / 9,
    
    exclusivism = case_when(
      Q170 %in% c(1,2) ~ 1,
      Q170 %in% c(3,4) ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    god = as.numeric(Q165),
    afterlife = as.numeric(Q166),
    hell = as.numeric(Q167),
    heaven = as.numeric(Q168)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    supernatural = rowMeans(
      cbind(god, afterlife, hell, heaven),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(anti_imm),
    !is.na(belief),
    !is.na(exclusivism),
    !is.na(supernatural)
  )


library(fixest)

model_sn <- feols(
  anti_imm ~ belief + exclusivism + supernatural | country,
  data = wvs_ind,
  cluster = ~country
)

summary(model_sn)

```
